newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba expects clear increase in 96 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Veba expects clear increase in 96 earnings.

text.p: German diversified utility Veba AG said on Wednesday it expected to see a clear increase in earnings in full-year 1996 and that it expected to maintain growth levels seen up to now.

The group said in a mandatory statement early on Wednesday: "We are confident that we will see a clear increase in earnings in the full year, based on the earnings growth seen in the first nine months of the year."
The group said fewer special charges and operative and structural measures to improve competitiveness in all areas of the group's activities would also help to boost profitability.
